request.description:
Creates a new trusted search page URI entry in a specific Coveo Cloud organization. Any search page whose URI begins with that prefix will be allowed to use the SAML SSO provider of that organization as a means of authentication.  
**Notes:**  
- No URI is trusted by default.  
- Creating a trusted search page URI entry with the empty string will result in **all** URIs being trusted, which is not recommended.
<details>
<summary>Privilege(s) required</summary>

```json
{"level":"NORMAL","owner":"SEARCH_API","targetDomain":"AUTHENTICATION_EDITOR","type":"ENABLE","targetId":"*"}
```
</details>

query.description: A line-separated list of additional fields to include.</br>**Example:** `license`</br>`status`
A line-separated list of additional fields to include.</br>**Example:** `license`</br>`status`
The free-form string to filter the returned list based on the values of the organization attributes. Using spaces is not recommended as it will prevent correct filtering.
The type of organization to include in the returned list.</br>**Example:** `Test`</br>By default, organizations of all types may be included in the response.
The field to sort the returned organizations by.</br>**Example:** `createdDate`</br>**Default:** `displayName`
The `sortBy` order to list the organizations in.</br>**Allowed values:**</br> - `ASC`: Ascending order.</br>- `DESC`: Descending order. </br>**Example:** `DESC`</br>**Default:** `ASC`
The 0-based index number of the page to list.</br>**Example:** `5`</br>**Default:** `0`
The maximum number of organizations to list per page.</br>**Example:** `50`</br>**Default:** `100`
